the  Netherlands

OIML Member State
The Netherlands		 Number R76/2006-NL1-13.05

Page 2 of 2

Accuracy class (III)
Maximum capacity 1,5 kg ≤ Max ≤ 30 kg
Verification scale interval e ≥ 0,5 g
Maximum number of scale intervals Single interval n ≤ 3000 (DS-500) divisions;
n ≤ 7500 (DS-502) divisions.
Multi interval n ≤ 1000 (DS-500) divisions per partial weighing range;
n ≤ 3000 (DS-502) divisions per partial weighing range.
Maximum partial weighing ranges 2
Temperature range -10 °C / +40 °C
Tare T ≤ -Max for single interval instruments
T ≤ -Max₁–e₁ for multi interval instruments
Weighing range(s) Single interval
Multi-interval
Application Intended to be used for direct sales to the public
Power supply voltage For DS-500: 9 - 12 V DC through an external AC/DC adapter;
For DS-502: 6 - 9 V DC through an external AC/DC adapter;
6 V DC through 4 C-type batteries.
Software identification V1.xx
101
